headline: Portland settles for a scoreless draw at South Carolina
dek: Miguel-Angel Hernandez recorded his eighth shutout at South Carolina to keep Portland unbeaten since early September, moving the WCC champion to fourteen wins and three draws against three losses. Its 50 goals still lead every program in the conference, with 24 conceded across the season.
displaced_by: Portland's winning streak ended with a scoreless draw at South Carolina, updating its draw count and Miguel-Angel Hernandez's shutout total.

pattern.text: Goals sort the top of the table and little else: Seattle U has scored as many as San Francisco and finished behind it, and LMU, with the fewest, is not bottom.

wire.line: San Diego's only conference defeat came against Portland, who then beat them again.

findings.text: Eight matches dated before any WCC side had a published result still carry none, and they belong to San Diego, Santa Clara, Saint Mary's College of California and LMU alone.
